heading: **17 January 2026**
body:
*Lysis of protein cultures*

10 mL of lysis buffer per 100 mL of induced culture → 30 min shaking \+ vortex → Freeze at \-80 degrees

*HT SELEX \+ Hia5 Checklist*

6. Prepare protein plate same as last round of SELEX  
7. Prepare fresh 1.55X SELEX Buffer Plates  
8. Write *Hia*5 program \[4.5 uL TF dilution buffer \+ 8.5 uL 1.55X SELEX Buffer \+ 5 uL DNA → Incubate 30 mins, RT → 1 uL dHia5 \+ 0.7 uL SAM \+ 4.3 uL Hia5 buffer\]  
9. Test Hia5 activity again with 25 uL reaction  
10. Set up PCR for lig147 and lig70N with PE2/3 plates \- prepare separate mastermix plates for this with PE\_F and PE\_R primers

*lig200 PCR*

Dilute this lig200 ssDNA 1:200 ⇒ 1 uL oligo \+ 199 uL TE buffer (lig200-dil200)

PCR 1 

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **Final diluted DNA** | **2** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **12.5** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **1.25** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **1.25** |
| **Water** | **8**  |
| **Total** | **25** |

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **8X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

Measure the concentration of this PCR product and run on an agarose gel.

*lig70N PCR1*

Dilute this lig70N annealed DNA 10-fold.

Prepare a 100X reaction mix:

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **ligN40w107 Ann** | **100** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **1250** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **125** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **125** |
| **Water** | **900**  |
| **Total** | **2500** |

Split mix into 25 uL per well for two 96-well PCR plates.

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **8X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

Pool the PCR product and run 20 uL of sample on a 1% agarose gel. Measure concentration of the PCR1 product.
title: Lysis of protein cultures
